about.text: A drinking yoghurt from MBM in the Faroe Islands, with a fresh, sour taste and very little fat (0.5 g per 100 g). It is fermented with Lactobacillus acidophilus and Bifidobacterium cultures, and comes in strawberry, raspberry, blueberry, blackcurrant, vanilla and tropical flavours.

sources.text: The cultures and flavours, from these pages.
